# ECCO + GrowthBook
Date: 2026-09-09 | Duration: 8m

## Summary
The team confirmed that the Growthbook proof of concept can be implemented entirely through Google Tag Manager, removing the need for front-end developer involvement and reducing coordination dependencies. Vito will lead the implementation using setup guides shared by Scott, while Giulio monitors progress and supports delivery. Slack and Teams will serve as the primary channels for documentation, troubleshooting, escalation, and rapid responses. Thomas and Nikho are available for front-end assistance if unexpected issues arise, and Scott and Logan can provide additional engineering support. The team agreed to pursue completion by the end of the week because contract requirements are expected to be finalized by month-end. Legal and administrative delays have been resolved, allowing the group to focus on technical delivery. Scott also proposed recurring check-ins, and final contract approval is expected shortly after a successful PoC.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, Google Tag Manager, GTM, integration, frontend developers, Slack channel, PoC, proof of concept

## Action Items

**Scott Keller**
Share GrowthBook GTM integration documentation and setup guides via Slack and Teams channels to the Ecco team (02:18)
Ensure the entire GrowthBook team has notifications enabled in Slack to respond quickly to Ecco’s queries (00:23)
Set up recurring check-in calls on Teams to monitor PoC integration progress (07:09)

**Giulio / Ecco**
Coordinate with Vito to start the GrowthBook integration using GTM and monitor progress (06:26)
Refer frontend development help requests internally to Thomas or Nikho if a blocker arises (02:45)
Engage with Scott to get added to Slack and Teams communication channels (03:41)

**Vito / Ecco**
Lead the GrowthBook PoC integration using GTM, reaching out for help through internal chat or GrowthBook channels if needed (06:26)

**Logan Bates**
Provide support and assist with engineering resources if any technical issues arise during the integration (05:41)
